title: Achilles Coffee Roasters
summary: Commercial tenant improvement converting a former flower shop into Achilles Coffee Roasters. The project included a new sandwich preparation kitchen, food service equipment layout, ADA accessibility improvements, and construction documents for permitting while maintaining the existing dining area.
projectDetails: 680 sq ft existing dining area retained
Conversion of a former flower shop into a commercial sandwich preparation kitchen
Commercial food preparation and equipment layout
ADA accessibility improvements including accessible dining accommodations
Commercial plumbing and grease interceptor coordination
Construction documents for City of San Diego permitting
highlights: Adaptive reuse of an existing commercial tenant space
Designed to support Achilles Coffee Roasters operations
County Health Department compliant kitchen design
Minimal impact to the existing customer dining area
